d:
The song that quietly steals your heart, now in stunning 8K Watch Churai Janda Eh, the sweet romantic hit by Jassie Gill, with music by Goldboy and lyrics by Nirmaan, remastered in ultra-high definition.
Jassie Gill's soft, charming vocals and Goldboy's breezy melody make this one of his most-loved love songs, and in 8K every frame looks sharper and brighter than ever
Credits:
Song - Churai Janda Eh (Full Video)
Singer - Jassie Gill
Music - Goldboy
Lyrics - Nirmaan
Mix & Master - Sameer Charnegaonkar
